name: scene-2
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE 1024x1536 portrait preschool coloring page faithfully showing this homecoming action: little PinPin hedgehog stands on left and gently pats Scooby's shoulder while the friendly floppy-eared, curled-tail dog lies in the center and looks lovingly at him. Papa hedgehog at upper-right pours water from a plain large jug into one large bowl on the ground. Recompose as three distinct full characters in a simple vertical arrangement, clear eye contact between child and dog, two Papa paws correctly hold jug, water stream clearly enters bowl. Simplify cottage behind to one arched door and a single round window with a cross; omit flowers, ivy, leaves, grass and decorative jug patterns. All characters and bowl fully visible. BOLD BLACK outlines only on fully OPAQUE PURE WHITE #FFFFFF paper, including all interiors and background; NO transparency. Large closed white coloring areas for a FOUR-YEAR-OLD using thick crayons. Simplified zigzag hedgehog quill silhouettes with few large inner shapes; dog smooth blank coat, no fur strokes. No grey, hatching, shading, gradients, shadows, dark coat fills, color, texture, words, captions, letters, numbers, frames or panels. Tiny black pupils/nose allowed. Friendly faces and clean print margins.

review.notes: Child gently pats dog, Papa pours into large bowl; complete distinct figures, broad white shapes and no lettering.
